Scoring Notes for Part D
• To earn P7, P8, and P9, the terms of the series can be presented in a list or as part of a polynomial or
series.
• P7 and P8 are independent of each other, and a response can earn one without earning the other.
• A response must earn P8 to be eligible for P9.
o Special case: A response that presents a polynomial that could be simplified to the correct three
terms will earn P8 but not P9.
• Extraneous terms are treated as scratch work and do not impact scoring of P7, P8, or P9.
• Read “=” as “” as needed.
